name: AutoComment
description: In-game comment reminders for Geometry Dash Android. Reminders show the level ID and prepared text; posting remains manual.

level-id.name: Level ID
level-id.description: Enter the numeric ID of the level you want to comment on.

comment-text.name: Comment text
comment-text.description: The comment text shown in each reminder. You submit it manually in Geometry Dash.

interval-minutes.name: Reminder interval (minutes)
interval-minutes.description: Reminder interval in minutes. Values below 5 are not allowed.

enabled.name: Enable reminders
enabled.description: Show reminders while the Geometry Dash main menu is open.
